task: Make a Hindi audio version of this whole chapter

steps: 1. Assess the supplied eight-page scanned PDF against the ₹0.50 budget; ocr_document costs ₹0.20 per scanned page.
2. If affordable, extract the whole chapter with ocr_document, translate its complete text to Hindi with translate_text, and generate verified Hindi audio with synthesize_speech.
3. If the full task is unaffordable, use finish to report the budget limitation without spending on an incomplete substitute.

The PDF is treated as a scanned chapter based on its filename and supplied metadata.
A default Hindi narration voice would be acceptable.
The ₹0.50 spending limit is binding; no partial chapter should replace the requested whole-chapter audio.
